description: The Mullet Pro is Here! Assembled in America Our first US-Assembled bike is the Mullet Pro. With upgrades throughout to the top brands of all major components, the new Mullet Pro is Cyberbike's flagship. The 2021 Cyberbike Mullet Pro Version 2 is an amazing value in a high performance eBike. 48 volt mid drive power, 13Ah battery for long rides, 130mm travel Sträva Boost forks and rear shock. 12- speed 11-500 tooth rear cassette makes the Mullet Pro our best climbing bike yet. SRAM derailleur and shifter, 203mm disk brakes and much more. 29/27.5 Maxxis Minion Tubeless Tires on WTB Wheels Bontrager Bars Sträva Euro Series long-travel, fully adjustable suspension, front and rear. 300mm bottom bracket ground clearance.
